options.text: The conversion of nitrates back into nitrogen gas
The conversion of ammonia into nitrites and then nitrates by nitrifying bacteria
The direct uptake of nitrogen gas by plant roots
The conversion of atmospheric nitrogen into ammonia by bacteria

questions.explanation: Nitrification is the process where nitrifying bacteria convert ammonia first into nitrites and then into nitrates. Nitrates are the form of nitrogen that plants can absorb through their roots and use to make amino acids and proteins.
